title: Conformationally frustrated epitaxy at heteromolecular interface
abstract: Precise control of molecular heteroepitaxy offers a route to multilayer architectures with well-defined interfaces. However, the role of intramolecular flexibility in epitaxial matching remains insufficiently understood. Here, we investigate the heteroepitaxy of intact 1,3,5-tris(4-carboxyphenyl)benzene (BTB) on a molecular $\delta$-layer composed of fully deprotonated BTB molecules on Ag(111). Combining scanning tunneling microscopy, low-energy electron microscopy and diffraction, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and density functional theory, we identify the key interactions controlling molecular packing and epitaxial growth. We show that intermolecular bonding motifs are preserved on the molecular template, but their lattice parameters and molecular conformations change as compared to a silver surface. Individual molecules exhibit distinct appearances in scanning tunneling microscopy, consistent with site-dependent conformational variations identified by theory. Our calculations reveal that the competition between molecule-substrate interactions and conformational energy produces different compromise geometries, resulting in conformational frustration at the epitaxial interface. Crucially, constraining BTB into a planar geometry changes the preferred lateral adsorption positions, demonstrating that molecular flexibility directly modifies the energetic preferences for epitaxial registry. Comparison with more rigid molecular overlayers further supports this interpretation. Our findings reveal that molecular flexibility contributes to epitaxial matching by allowing unfavorable molecule-substrate interactions to be compensated by energetically favorable conformations while preserving the intermolecular network.

summaries.en: Intramolecular flexibility in BTB molecules on a molecular δ-layer template produces conformationally frustrated epitaxy, in which competition between molecule-substrate interactions and conformational energy yields site-dependent compromise geometries that alter the preferred epitaxial registry while preserving the intermolecular bonding motifs.
summaries.zh: 在由完全去质子化BTB分子构成的分子δ层模板上，BTB分子的分子内柔性导致构象受挫的外延生长，其中分子-衬底相互作用与构象能之间的竞争产生随位点变化的折中几何构型，从而改变优选的横向吸附位置和外延匹配方式，同时保持分子间键合基元不变。
summaries.ja: 完全に脱プロトン化したBTB分子からなる分子δ層テンプレート上でのBTBのエピタキシーでは、分子－基板相互作用と配座エネルギーの競合がサイト依存の妥協的な幾何構造を生み、分子間結合モチーフを保ったまま好ましいエピタキシャル配向を変化させる配座フラストレーションが現れる。

title: Rotational Doppler Effect and Helimagnon Frequency Comb in Sliding Magnetic Spirals
abstract: Collective spin motion can reshape magnon spectra by providing a dynamical magnetic background. Magnetic spirals offer a particularly clean setting, as they simultaneously host propagating helimagnons and a gapless Goldstone mode, i.e., the sliding of the spiral. Here, we show that once a helimagnon is excited and the spiral slides, the motion, which rotates the local spin frame, produces a thresholdless rotational Doppler shift of the helimagnon spectrum, with even winding for the linear mode and odd winding for its second harmonic. Stronger excitation generates one finite-momentum phason. Mixing of that phason with the helimagnon produces a helimagnon frequency comb only inside a finite driving window, spaced by the phason frequency fixed by the spiral length rather than by the sliding rate. These two scales are separable in a microwave experiment: the Doppler offset tracks the sliding velocity, whereas the comb spacing scales inversely with the length of the spiral.

summaries.en: In a sliding magnetic spiral, helimagnons experience a thresholdless rotational Doppler shift, and their mixing with a finite-momentum phason generates a helimagnon frequency comb whose spacing is set by the phason frequency (determined by the spiral length) rather than by the sliding rate.
summaries.zh: 在滑移的磁螺旋中，螺旋磁振子会经历无阈值的旋转多普勒频移，且其与有限动量相子的混合会生成螺旋磁振子频率梳，其梳齿间距由相子频率（取决于螺旋长度）而非滑移速率决定。
summaries.ja: 滑り運動する磁気スパイラル中では、ヘリマグノンが閾値なしの回転ドップラーシフトを受け、有限運動量のフェイソンとの混合により、滑り速度ではなくスパイラル長で決まるフェイソン周波数で間隔が定まるヘリマグノン周波数コムが生じる。

title: Spontaneous Formation of Lateral Defect-Density Gradient in CVD-Grown MoS2 Monolayers
abstract: Defect engineering in two-dimensional materials is a powerful strategy for tuning electronic, optical, and catalytic properties. While pristine molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) has been thoroughly studied, defective MoS2 remains poorly understood due to the complexity and inconsistency of controlled defect creation. Here, we report a defect-density gradient that forms spontaneously in MoS2 flakes during chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth. Photoluminescence and Raman spectroscopy mapping reveal the lateral arrangement of this gradient across a single flake. Deconvolution of the excitonic photoluminescence emission identifies electron doping as the key factor governing the spatial variation in optical response. This doping likely originates from sulfur vacancies formed during CVD growth, as further supported by the observed Raman mode shifts. We propose that this gradient arises from precursor depletion near the nucleation center during growth, resulting in a gradual variation in defect density. This lateral defect structure provides a convenient platform for systematically characterizing defective MoS2 across a continuous range of defect densities within a single sample. The sulfur-vacancy-driven surface activation identified here can also be important for future catalytic applications.
subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: CVD-grown MoS2 monolayers spontaneously develop a lateral sulfur-vacancy defect-density gradient due to precursor depletion near the nucleation center, which causes spatially varying electron doping and optical response within a single flake.
summaries.zh: CVD生长的MoS2单层由于成核中心附近前驱体耗尽而自发形成横向硫空位缺陷密度梯度，导致同一薄片内电子掺杂和光学响应出现空间变化。
summaries.ja: CVD成長したMoS2単層は、核形成中心付近での前駆体枯渇により横方向の硫黄空孔欠陥密度勾配を自発的に形成し、単一フレーク内で電子ドーピングと光学応答に空間的な変化を生じさせる。

title: Pressure-induced symmetry breaking and polarity in the van der Waals magnet CrSBr
abstract: The van der Waals magnet CrSBr has emerged as a fascinating platform for exploring coupled structural, magnetic, and electronic phenomena. Yet, the evolution of its crystal symmetry and electronic states under pressure and temperature remains unresolved. To elucidate this we employ low-temperature single-crystal X-ray diffraction, Raman scattering and photoluminescence measurements under hydrostatic pressures of up to 12 GPa, complemented by first-principles this http URL observe a cascade of pressure-induced structural transitions from the orthorhombic $Pmmn$ to monoclinic $P2_1/m$ phase at $\approx$ 1.5 GPa, followed by the emergence of a polar orthorhombic $Pmm$2 phase $\approx$ 6.5 GPa. The change in symmetry is accompanied by phonon anomalies and a direct-to-indirect bandgap crossover. Our results demonstrate pressure as a knob to engineer structure, symmetry and electronic properties in CrSBr in a coupled manner.

summaries.en: Low-temperature X-ray diffraction, Raman, and photoluminescence measurements under hydrostatic pressure up to 12 GPa, supported by first-principles calculations, reveal that CrSBr undergoes a cascade of pressure-induced structural transitions from orthorhombic Pmmn to monoclinic P2_1/m at about 1.

title: A Compact High-Repetition-Rate Intense THz Source for Atomic-Scale Materials Characterization
abstract: High-intensity terahertz (THz) sources combining high repetition rates, strong field amplitudes, and long-term stability are key enabling technologies for next-generation ultrafast photonics. However, simultaneously achieving these characteristics in a compact and practical architecture remains a major challenge. Here, we report a high-performance tabletop THz source delivering intense single-cycle pulses at 100 kHz, generated by optical rectification in lithium niobate using an optimized echelon-based tilted-pulse-front scheme and driven by an industrial-grade ytterbium laser. The source achieves optical-to-THz conversion efficiencies exceeding 0.13% at room temperature, peak electric fields of several hundred kV/cm, and excellent long-term stability, establishing a robust platform for high-average-power strong-field THz applications. As a proof of concept, the source was integrated into an atom probe tomography (APT) instrument. APT reconstructs the three-dimensional chemical composition of materials through field-induced ion emission from a sharp nanotip. While THz-assisted ion emission has been shown to improve analytical performance by reducing thermal effects, previous demonstrations were limited to low-repetition-rate THz sources, restricting throughput and accessible analysis volumes. Using an aluminum nanotip, we demonstrate efficient THz-assisted APT at 100 kHz and benchmark its performance against conventional voltage- and laser-assisted operation. The high repetition rate enables rapid large-volume acquisition while improving mass resolving power, reducing thermal tailing, and preserving high-quality three-dimensional reconstructions. Beyond APT, this work establishes a compact and scalable high-repetition-rate THz platform for strong-field physics, nonlinear THz photonics, ultrafast spectroscopy, and material characterization at the nanoscale.

summaries.en: The paper reports a compact 100 kHz tabletop terahertz source based on tilted-pulse-front optical rectification in lithium niobate driven by an industrial ytterbium laser, achieving >0.
summaries.zh: 该论文报道了一种紧凑的100 kHz台式太赫兹源，基于铌酸锂中的倾斜脉冲前沿光整流并由工业级镱激光器驱动，实现了超过0.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、産業用イッテルビウムレーザーで駆動されるニオブ酸リチウム中の傾斜パルス波面光整流に基づく、100 kHzで動作するコンパクトな卓上テラヘルツ源を報告し、0.

title: Stacking, symmetry and exciton fine structure in boron nitride bilayers
abstract: Engineering of two-dimensional material heterostructures offers a broad range of degrees of freedom through the selection of type and number of layers and their relative stacking configurations. In these compound materials, the stacking sequence plays a central role in determining electronic, mechanical, and optical properties. Here, we present a theoretical study of its signature on the excitons of hexagonal boron nitride bilayers based on first-principle calculations within the GW approximation and the Bethe-Salpeter equation. We explain how stacking-dependent symmetry variations lead to distinct electronic structures, particularly near the band edge around the K high-symmetry point, and consequently to markedly different excitonic landscapes. Indeed, we analyze the symmetry-governed character of the low-lying excitonic states, identifying their bright or dark nature for each stacking configuration and performing a systematic comparison. Our results clarify how van der Waals interlayer coupling reshapes excitons in hexagonal boron nitride bilayers and outline prospects for twist-controlled exciton engineering in this material.

summaries.en: First-principles GW and Bethe-Salpeter calculations show that stacking-dependent symmetry variations in hexagonal boron nitride bilayers produce distinct band-edge electronic structures near K and markedly different excitonic landscapes, with low-lying states identified as bright or dark for each stacking configuration.
summaries.zh: 基于第一性原理GW近似和Bethe-Salpeter方程的计算表明，六方氮化硼双层中随堆叠方式变化的对称性差异会在K点附近产生不同的带边电子结构，进而形成显著不同的激子图景，并确定了各堆叠构型下低能激子态的亮态或暗态性质。
summaries.ja: 第一原理GW近似とBethe-Salpeter方程式に基づく計算により、六方晶窒化ホウ素二層では積層に依存する対称性の変化がK点近傍のバンド端電子構造を変え、その結果として著しく異なる励起子描像を生じることが示され、各積層配置における低エネルギー励起子状態の明状態・暗状態の性質が同定された。

title: Quantum Interference Control of Coupled Atomic Spins
abstract: We propose a protocol for the non-resonant electric control of quantum states in atomic-scale spin systems using Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana (LZSM) interferometry. We focus on a Ti-Ti-Fe trimer on a thin MgO layer, a platform that has recently emerged as a promising candidate for qubit realization using electron spin resonance combined with scanning tunneling microscopy (ESR-STM). We first analyze a Ti dimer in the absence of the Fe atom and show, through a detailed spectroscopic study, that avoided level crossings can be engineered by combining the in-plane component of the external magnetic field, the tip magnetic field, and the applied bias voltage, which allows the system to be tuned electrically through these crossings. Based on this, we develop LZSM protocols for coherent state control in the dimer using non-resonant LZSM-STM. We then consider the full trimer, where the Fe atom generates a local magnetic field at the remote Ti atom, enabling non-local spin control. We show that this remote and non-resonant manipulation reduces unwanted effects associated with tunneling electrons and enables quantum operations on short timescales. Our results show that quantum interference can be used as a resource for electrically driven, non-resonant, and non-local spin control in atomic-scale systems. This approach enables fast quantum operations while mitigating decoherence, offering a promising route toward scalable atom-based qubit architectures.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana interferometry protocol that uses non-resonant electric fields and engineered avoided level crossings to achieve non-local, non-resonant control of coupled atomic spins in a Ti-Ti-Fe trimer on MgO, enabling fast quantum operations while mitigating decoherence.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana干涉的非共振电控方案，通过可调控的能级避免交叉在MgO上的Ti-Ti-Fe三聚体中实现对耦合原子自旋的非局域、非共振控制，从而在抑制退相干的同时实现快速量子操作。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana干渉法を用いて、MgO上のTi-Ti-Fe三量体における結合原子スピンを非共鳴電場で非局所的に制御するプロトコルを提案し、デコヒーレンスを抑えつつ高速な量子操作を可能にすることを示した。

title: Scanning Probe Control, Quantum Dynamics, and Dispersive Readout of Suspended Carbon Nanotube Resonators
abstract: Suspended carbon nanotubes (CNTs) offer promising opportunities for quantum nanomechanics owing to their small effective mass, strong electrostatic tunability, and mechanical nonlinearity. We develop a unified theoretical framework for coherent control and readout of a suspended CNT driven by an atomic force microscope (AFM) tip and capacitively coupled to a Cooper-pair box (CPB). We first derive the linear and nonlinear Duffing response of the CNT and quantify the effects of AFM force gradients, tip-position fluctuations, and voltage noise on mechanical stability, dephasing, and heating. These results establish operating conditions for coherent actuation with limited backaction. We then quantize the Duffing oscillator, derive its Kerr anharmonicity, and identify the requirements for selective control of individual vibrational transitions. Estimates of thermal occupation and active cooling illustrate the constraints for CNT modes spanning frequencies from 54 MHz to 5.37 GHz. Finally, we derive the CNT--CPB interaction and its dispersive limit, showing how phonon number and parity can be mapped onto the CPB through Ramsey interferometry and detected using quantum-capacitance readout. The resulting framework identifies the conditions under which localized AFM actuation, nonlinear quantum dynamics, and superconducting state-resolved detection can operate within a single CNT device.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper develops a unified theoretical framework for an AFM-tip-actuated suspended carbon nanotube Duffing resonator capacitively coupled to a Cooper-pair box, analyzing its linear and nonlinear dynamics, Kerr anharmonicity, thermal occupation at 54 MHz–5.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，用于描述由原子力显微镜探针驱动、并与库珀对盒电容耦合的悬浮碳纳米管杜芬谐振子，分析了其线性与非线性动力学、克尔非谐性、54 MHz至5.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、原子間力顕微鏡探針で駆動されクーパー対箱と容量結合した懸架カーボンナノチューブのDuffing共振器について、線形・非線形ダイナミクス、Kerr非調和性、54 MHzから5.

title: Quantum-walk measurements with sequential imaging of the same atomic sample
abstract: We demonstrate sequential single-atom-resolved imaging of the same ultracold atomic sample and apply this technique to quantum-walk measurements in an optical lattice. In quantum gas microscope experiments, fluorescence imaging provides microscopic information on atomic distributions but induces motional heating through photon scattering, making it difficult to reuse the same sample for subsequent quantum dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we apply Raman sideband cooling with parameters optimized for post-imaging cooling, enabling sequential single-atom-resolved measurements of the same sample. By optimizing the cooling parameters with machine learning, we achieve high fidelity over multiple imaging cycles. To demonstrate the capability of this technique, we measure one-dimensional quantum walks of single atoms in an optical lattice. By determining the initial atomic positions from fluorescence images, we extract quantum-walk transition probabilities without requiring deterministic preparation of the initial atomic positions. The observed dynamics agree with numerical simulations of quantum walks of single atoms. Our method provides a route toward reducing experimental overhead in quantum gas microscope studies requiring repeated acquisition of spatially resolved correlation data.

summaries.en: By optimizing Raman sideband cooling with machine learning, the authors achieve sequential single-atom-resolved fluorescence imaging of the same ultracold atomic sample and use it to measure one-dimensional quantum walks in an optical lattice, extracting transition probabilities without deterministic initial-position preparation.
summaries.zh: 作者利用机器学习优化拉曼边带冷却，实现了对同一超冷原子样品的连续单原子分辨荧光成像，并将其用于测量光晶格中单原子的量子行走，在无需确定性制备初始位置的情况下提取了量子行走跃迁概率。
summaries.ja: 機械学習でラマンサイドバンド冷却を最適化することで、同一の極低温原子サンプルに対する逐次的な単一原子分解蛍光イメージングを実現し、光格子中の単一原子の一次元量子ウォークを測定して、初期位置の決定論的準備なしに遷移確率を抽出した。

title: Inversion symmetry breaking by interlayer hybridization in a tetralayer van der Waals heterostructure
abstract: Inversion symmetry breaking unlocks a broad range of physical phenomena fundamental for modern technologies, motivating efforts to engineer noncentrosymmetric materials. In this context, monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides, which naturally lack inversion symmetry, have emerged as a versatile platform for valley physics, strong excitonic effects, and nonlinear optics. However, in their hexagonal stacking phase, inversion symmetry is restored in even-layer stacks and bulk form, suppressing these effects and limiting applications. In this work, inversion symmetry breaking is demonstrated in a vertically stacked tetralayer heterostructure assembled from two intrinsically centrosymmetric bilayer flakes, as evidenced by second harmonic generation measurements with an intensity comparable to that of their constituent monolayer. Spectroscopic measurements and theoretical estimations indicate that effective symmetry breaking in the tetralayer heterostructure is driven by interlayer hybridization, giving rise to pronounced electronic and phononic signatures. This symmetry breaking further induces polar anisotropy, with an intensity ratio reaching 2.36. We propose that asymmetric contributions from excitons to the second harmonic optical dipole may influence this behavior. These findings establish interlayer coupling as a critical mechanism for introducing inversion symmetry breaking and tuning the optical response of van der Waals heterostructures, providing a powerful strategy for photonics and optoelectronics in two-dimensional materials.

summaries.en: This study demonstrates inversion symmetry breaking in a tetralayer van der Waals heterostructure assembled from two centrosymmetric bilayers, evidenced by strong second harmonic generation driven by interlayer hybridization and accompanied by polar anisotropy.
summaries.zh: 本研究证明了由两个中心对称双层薄片堆叠而成的四层范德华异质结中存在反演对称性破缺，其强二次谐波产生由层间杂化驱动，并伴随极性各向异性。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、中心対称な2枚の二層フレークからなる四層ファンデルワールスヘテロ構造において、層間混成に駆動された強い第二高調波発生と極性異方性を伴う反転対称性の破れを実証した。

title: Theory of Optical and Magneto-Optical Properties of [111]-Oriented Site-Controlled Quantum Dots
abstract: Site-controlled [111]-oriented quantum dots (QDs) are promising sources of non-classical light, yet their optical spectra exhibit apparently conflicting symmetry signatures. At zero magnetic field, excitonic spectra are commonly interpreted as $C_{2v}$-like, whereas measurements in Faraday geometry display selection rules characteristic of $C_{3v}$-like symmetry. Here, we show that both regimes can be described consistently without invoking any change in the underlying structural symmetry. Combining 8-band $\mathbf{k}\cdot\mathbf{p}$ theory, a self-consistent Hartree-informed configuration interaction scheme, and group theoretical analysis, we introduce a controlled symmetry reducing perturbation that lowers the QD symmetry to $C_s$. At zero field, the optical response remains predominantly $C_{2v}$-like because the additional low-symmetry transitions carry only weak oscillator strengths. In Faraday geometry, the same reduced-symmetry structure produces four dominant, nearly circularly polarised trion transitions, reproducing the experimentally observed $C_{3v}$-like response. By contrast, an exact $C_{2v}$ description inferred from the zero-field spectrum permits only two such trion transitions and therefore fails at finite field. Our results thus provide a unified description of the zero and finite magnetic field optical response without any restoration or enhancement of the underlying structural symmetry. More generally, we demonstrate that a higher-symmetry-like optical spectrum does not uniquely identify the exact symmetry of a QD, therefore also providing useful guidance for other QD and nanostructure systems that lie beyond the ones studied here.

summaries.en: A controlled symmetry-reducing perturbation to Cs combined with 8-band k·p theory, Hartree-informed configuration interaction, and group theory explains both the predominantly C2v-like zero-field excitonic spectra and the C3v-like Faraday-geometry trion selection rules of [111]-oriented site-controlled quantum dots without any change in structural symmetry.
summaries.zh: 通过引入将量子点对称性降低至Cs的受控对称性微扰，并结合8带k·p理论、Hartree修正的组态相互作用和群论分析，可以在不改变结构对称性的前提下统一解释[111]取向定位量子点在零磁场下以C2v为主的激子光谱和法拉第几何下类C3v的三子选择定则。
summaries.ja: 8バンドk·p理論、Hartree補正を組み込んだ配置間相互作用、群論解析を組み合わせ、対称性をCsに低下させる制御された摂動を導入することで、構造対称性を変化させることなく、[111]配向サイト制御量子ドットのゼロ磁場での主にC2v的な励起子スペクトルとファラデー配置でのC3v的なトリオン選択則を統一的に説明できる。

title: Cavity-enhanced second harmonic generation from Rydberg excitons in Cu$_2$O
abstract: Rydberg excitons in Cu$_2$O provide a solid-state setting for creating giant optical nonlinearities. Here, we use second-harmonic generation (SHG) to study Rydberg excitons in a doubly resonant optical microcavity designed to enhance both the pump and second-harmonic fields. We observe even-parity exciton states in an optical cavity and extend cavity-based measurements of Rydberg excitons up to $n=10$. The SHG intensity depends strongly on pump cavity detuning, showing the dominant role of the microcavity is the enhancement of the intra-cavity pump field. Analysis reveals an additional enhancement from the resonant second-harmonic cavity giving an overall SHG enhancement factor of $21 \pm 2$ inside the microcavity. These results establish cavity-enhanced SHG spectroscopy as a valuable tool for studying Rydberg excitons in microcavities and provide a pathway towards exploiting optical nonlinearities in Rydberg exciton polariton systems.

summaries.en: Using a doubly resonant optical microcavity, second-harmonic generation from Rydberg excitons in Cu2O is enhanced by an overall factor of 21 ± 2, with even-parity states observed up to n = 10 and the pump-field enhancement dominating over the resonant second-harmonic enhancement.
summaries.zh: 利用双共振光学微腔，Cu2O中里德堡激子的二次谐波产生获得了21 ± 2的总增强因子，观测到高达n = 10的偶宇称激子态，且泵浦场的增强起主导作用而非共振二次谐波的增强。
summaries.ja: 二重共振光マイクロキャビティを用いることで、Cu2O中のリュードベリ励起子からの第二高調波発生が全体で21 ± 2倍に増強され、n = 10までの偶パリティ励起子状態が観測されるとともに、ポンプ場の増強が共鳴第二高調波の増強よりも支配的であることが示された。

title: Raman anyon-Hubbard model in a 1D Bose lattice gas
abstract: The anyon-Hubbard model is the paradigmatic lattice model of one-dimensional (1D) anyons, in which chiral interactions make bosons equivalent to particles with fractional statistics. Its continuum limit, the chiral BF theory, emerges as the low-energy description of a Raman-coupled Bose gas with imbalanced interactions. Here, we show that loading such a gas into a 1D optical lattice realizes the lattice counterpart of this theory, which we name the Raman anyon-Hubbard model. The Raman-dressed bosons acquire density-dependent Peierls phases when tunneling through occupied sites. For a small statistical phase, the model reduces to the anyon-Hubbard model, while beyond this limit it defines a distinct lattice anyon model with unbounded rather than periodic statistical interactions. Numerically, we show that the dressed gas displays the defining properties of 1D anyons, namely a density-dependent asymmetry of the ground-state momentum distribution, interaction-induced asymmetric transport and chiral bound states. Remarkably, these features are readily accessible with Raman-coupled $^{39}$K atoms, opening up the experimental exploration of 1D anyons beyond the few-particle regime.

summaries.en: Loading a Raman-coupled Bose gas with imbalanced interactions into a 1D optical lattice realizes the Raman anyon-Hubbard model, in which density-dependent Peierls phases give rise to density-dependent asymmetry of the ground-state momentum distribution, interaction-induced asymmetric transport, and chiral bound states accessible with 39K atoms.
summaries.zh: 将具有不平衡相互作用的拉曼耦合玻色气体装入一维光晶格可实现拉曼任意子-哈伯德模型，其中依赖密度的Peierls相位产生基态动量分布的密度依赖不对称性、相互作用诱导的不对称输运以及手征束缚态，并可在39K原子中实现。
summaries.ja: 相互作用の不均衡を持つラマン結合ボース気体を1次元光格子に装荷することでラマン・エニオン–ハバード模型が実現し、密度依存のパイエルス位相が基底状態運動量分布の密度依存非対称性、相互作用誘起の非対称輸送、カイラル束縛状態を生み出し、これらは39K原子で利用可能である。

title: Rotating Black Holes in Perfect Fluid Dark Matter: Horizons, Photon Orbits, and Shadows
abstract: We investigate rotating black holes surrounded by perfect-fluid dark matter (PFDM), described by the parameter \(k\), and determine the Kerr-connected region of the \((a/M,k/M)\) parameter space that contains an event horizon. The critical value \(k_{\mathrm c}(a)\), obtained from the degenerate-horizon conditions \(\Delta(r_{\mathrm c})=\Delta'(r_{\mathrm c})=0\), defines the boundary between black-hole and horizonless configurations. We derive an exact parametric form of this extremal boundary and show that its near-Kerr behavior includes a logarithmic correction; therefore, \(k_{\mathrm c}/M\simeq2.8828(1-a/M)^{1.5377}\) is only an empirical fit over \(0.90\leq a/M\leq0.999\), not an asymptotic scaling law. For horizon-bearing solutions, we calculate unstable spherical photon orbits and the shadow's mean radius, area, and distortion, finding that increasing \(k/M\) shifts the photon region inward and reduces the shadow size. Backward ray tracing through a phenomenological optically thin disk, tested on independent \(41^2\), \(81^2\), and \(161^2\) image grids, confirms this trend: for \(a/M=0.9\) and an inclination of \(17^\circ\), the \(20~\mu\mathrm{as}\) beam-convolved ridge diameter decreases from \(42.47\) to \(37.88~\mu\mathrm{as}\) as \(k/M\) increases from 0 to \(0.08\), with the two finest grids agreeing to within \(0.5\%\). Thus, PFDM produces a consistent contraction from the horizon and photon region to the geometric shadow and image ridge, although these illustrative images do not provide an Event Horizon Telescope constraint because they lack a self-consistent emission model and interferometric likelihood analysis.

summaries.en: The paper determines the Kerr-connected horizon existence region for rotating black holes in perfect-fluid dark matter, derives an exact extremal boundary with logarithmic near-Kerr corrections, and shows that increasing the dark-matter parameter shifts photon orbits inward and contracts the shadow and image ridge while cautioning that the illustrative images do not yield Event Horizon Telescope constraints.
summaries.zh: 本文确定了完美流体暗物质中旋转黑洞的Kerr连通视界存在区域，推导出带有对数近Kerr修正的精确极端边界，并表明增大暗物质参数会使光子轨道向内移动、使阴影和图像脊收缩，同时指出这些示意性图像因缺乏自洽辐射模型和干涉似然分析而不能给出事件视界望远镜限制。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、完全流体暗黒物質中の回転ブラックホールについて事象の地平面が存在するKerr連結領域を決定し、対数的な near-Kerr 補正を含む極限境界の厳密形を導出するとともに、暗黒物質パラメータの増加が光子軌道を内側へ移動させ影と画像リッジを収縮させることを示し、これらの例示的画像は自己無撞着な放射モデルと干渉計的尤度解析を欠くため事象の地平線望遠鏡の制約を与えないと注意している。

title: Tailoring resonator geometry for astigmatism compensation with structured light in birefringent optical cavities
abstract: In this work, we experimentally investigate the astigmatism induced by a birefringent crystal inside an optical cavity and demonstrate a geometric compensation strategy for structured modes carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM). We show that the astigmatism observed in the semimonolithic configuration can be fully compensated by introducing a third mirror to fold the cavity, thereby exploiting the geometric astigmatism arising from oblique incidence on the curved mirror. By performing a study of the resonator geometry, both theoretical and experimental results confirm that this approach enables the preservation of OAM between the pump beam and the converted signal and idler modes, providing an effective design strategy for birefringent optical cavities.

summaries.en: This work experimentally investigates astigmatism induced by a birefringent crystal inside an optical cavity and demonstrates that it can be fully compensated geometrically by folding the cavity with a third mirror, exploiting the astigmatism from oblique incidence on the curved mirror to preserve orbital angular momentum between pump, signal, and idler modes.
summaries.zh: 本工作实验研究了光学腔内双折射晶体引起的像散，并证明通过引入第三面镜子折叠腔体、利用曲面镜斜入射产生的几何像散，可以完全补偿半整体腔配置中的像散，从而在泵浦光与转换的信号光和闲频光之间保持轨道角动量。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、光共振器内の複屈折結晶によって生じる非点収差を実験的に調べ、第三のミラーで共振器を折り畳むことで曲面鏡への斜入射に由来する幾何学的非点収差を利用してセミモノリシック構成の非点収差を完全に補償し、ポンプ光と変換されたシグナル光・アイドラー光の間で軌道角運動量を保持できることを示した。

title: Modulation Induced Memory Resonances in Dynamically Driven Optical Cavities
abstract: Temporal modulation of optical cavities provides a powerful mechanism for controlling photonic states beyond the static cavity paradigm. Here, we investigate the dynamics of periodically driven optical cavities using a time-dependent cavity-field model with modulated resonance frequencies. We demonstrate modulation-induced tuning of cavity resonances and analyze the resulting intracavity field evolution in both amplitude and phase. The interplay between periodic modulation and cavity dissipation gives rise to pronounced hysteretic behavior, revealing memory effects associated with the finite photon lifetime of the cavity. By quantifying the hysteresis area as a function of modulation frequency, we identify distinct memory resonances characterized by enhanced field-history dependence at specific driving frequencies. Furthermore, we examine the time-resolved local density of optical states (LDOS) and show that temporal modulation enables dynamic spectral redistribution of photonic states, with the degree of confinement governed by the cavity loss rate. Our results establish a simple framework for understanding and engineering memory effects in dynamically driven optical resonators and provide new opportunities for tunable photonic environments, dynamic LDOS control, and reconfigurable light-matter interactions.

summaries.en: This paper theoretically shows that periodically modulating the resonance frequencies of a dissipative optical cavity produces hysteresis and memory effects tied to the finite photon lifetime, yields distinct memory resonances at specific modulation frequencies, and enables dynamic spectral redistribution and time-resolved control of the local density of optical states governed by the cavity loss rate.
summaries.zh: 本文通过含时腔场模型研究表明，周期性调制耗散光学腔的共振频率会产生与有限光子寿命相关的迟滞和记忆效应，在特定调制频率下出现明显的记忆共振，并可实现由腔损耗速率决定的局域光学态密度动态谱重分布与时间分辨调控。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、散逸性光共振器の共鳴周波数を周期的に変調することで、有限なフォトン寿命に起因する履歴現象と記憶効果が生じ、特定の変調周波数において顕著な記憶共鳴が現れるとともに、共振器損失率に支配された局所光学状態密度の動的なスペクトル再分布と時間分解制御が可能となることを示した。

title: Deep-UV All-dielectric qBIC Metasurface for Refractive Index Sensing
abstract: All-dielectric metasurfaces supporting quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) have emerged as powerful platforms for biosensing, yet their operation remains largely concentrated in the visible and near-infrared regimes. Extending these resonances into the deep-ultraviolet (DUV) to probe the intrinsic electronic absorption of biomolecules presents substantial material and nanofabrication challenges. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a hafnium dioxide (HfO$_{2}$) metasurface supporting DUV qBICs in the wavelength range from 225 nm to 340 nm with quality factors reaching 500. We further demonstrate its refractive index sensing capabilities through integration with a microfluidic cell and optical characterization in reflection mode. We show that the introduction of an aqueous buffer leads to a further quality factor enhancement. Achieving a sensitivity of up to approximately 60 nm/RIU and an operational figure of merit of 40 $\mathrm{RIU}^{-1}$, this low-loss HfO$_{2}$ metasurface provides a robust foundation for label-free DUV biosensing.

summaries.en: The authors experimentally demonstrate a low-loss hafnium dioxide all-dielectric metasurface supporting deep-ultraviolet quasi-bound states in the continuum from 225 to 340 nm with quality factors reaching 500, and show refractive index sensing with an aqueous buffer yielding a sensitivity of up to ~60 nm/RIU and a figure of merit of 40 RIU^-1.
summaries.zh: 作者实验展示了一种低损耗二氧化铪全介质超表面，可在225至340纳米的深紫外波段支持品质因数高达500的准连续域束缚态，并借助水相缓冲液实现了约60 nm/RIU的灵敏度和40 RIU^-1的品质因数用于折射率传感。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、225～340 nmの深紫外域で品質因子500に達する準連続体束縛状態を支持する低損失な二酸化ハフニウム全誘電体メタサーフェスを実験的に実証し、水系バッファーの導入により約60 nm/RIUの感度と40 RIU^-1の性能指数を持つ屈折率センシングを示した。

title: Laser-Direct-Written polymer WGM microring laser integrated on a fiber tip for refractive index sensing
abstract: Whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) microlasers are promising for refractometric sensing, but their practical implementation can be limited by the need for stable resonator-coupler alignment. Here, we demonstrate a Rhodamine B-doped polymer WGM microring laser directly fabricated on an optical-fiber tip, eliminating the external resonator-fiber coupling interface at the sensing head. Micro-droplet coating and UV laser direct writing are combined for fabrication, while finite-difference time-domain simulations guide the microring laser design. The microlasers operate in air and water with thresholds of 0.224 uJ and 0.458 uJ, respectively. Refractometric measurements in aqueous glucose solutions yield a bulk refractive index sensitivity of 364.95 nm/RIU and a detection limit of 2.47 x 10^(-4) RIU. Water-induced polymer changes and photobleaching are also investigated. This fiber-tip architecture provides a basis for probe-based refractometric sensing in environmental and biochemical applications.

summaries.en: A Rhodamine B-doped polymer whispering-gallery-mode microring laser was directly fabricated on an optical-fiber tip via micro-droplet coating and UV laser direct writing, achieving lasing thresholds of 0.
summaries.zh: 通过微液滴涂覆和紫外激光直写技术，在光纤尖端直接制备了掺罗丹明B的聚合物回音壁模式微环激光器，其在空气和水中的激光阈值分别为0.
summaries.ja: 微小液滴コーティングと紫外レーザー直接描画により光ファイバー先端にローダミンB添加ポリマーウィスパリングギャラリーモード微小リングレーザーを直接作製し、空気中および水中でそれぞれ0.

title: Differential chiral sensing at exceptional points in intrinsically chiral metastructures
abstract: Discriminating opposite enantiomers through their weak chiroptical responses remains a fundamental challenge in optical sensing. Exceptional points (EPs), non-Hermitian singularities at which eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, offer a route to enhanced spectral responses through their characteristic square-root eigenvalue splitting. However, their potential for chiral discrimination remains largely unexplored. We demonstrate exceptional points in an intrinsically chiral hybrid metamaterial and reveal strongly asymmetric responses to enantiomeric perturbations. The interplay between intrinsic chirality and non-Hermitian degeneracy is realized through the coupling of a chiral plasmonic nanoantenna array to a photonic crystal slab. We observe characteristic complex-square-root scaling, with both resonance frequencies and loss-rates exhibiting pronounced handedness dependence. Remarkably, opposite enantiomers produce complex mode splittings that differ by more than an order of magnitude. Our findings establish intrinsic chirality as a new degree of freedom in non-Hermitian physics and reveal a fundamental route toward topological singularities enhanced discrimination of chiral matter.

summaries.en: By coupling a chiral plasmonic nanoantenna array to a photonic crystal slab, the authors realize exceptional points in an intrinsically chiral metastructure and show that opposite enantiomers produce complex mode splittings differing by more than an order of magnitude.
summaries.zh: 作者通过将手性等离激元纳米天线阵列与光子晶体平板耦合，在本征手性超结构中实现了奇异点，并发现相反对映体所产生的复模式劈裂相差一个数量级以上。
summaries.ja: キラルなプラズモニックナノアンテナアレイをフォトニック結晶スラブに結合することで、著者らは本質的キラルなメタ構造において例外点を実現し、反対のエナンチオマーが桁違いに異なる複素モード分裂を生じることを示した。

title: Self-injection-locked dark-soliton Kerr optical frequency combs with high even-order normal dispersion
abstract: We numerically investigate dissipative dark-soliton (DDS) microcombs under the action of pure high even-order normal (HEON) dispersion in a microresonator with the self-injection locking (SIL). Pure 4th, 6th, 10th, and 14th-order normal dispersion can support DDSs formed by interlocked switching waves, directly excited through a SIL-based turnkey scheme without detuning sweeps. Compared to the pure 4th-order case, the switching-wave tail oscillation period increases and its decay rate decreases with the increase of the dispersion order. Although the overall comb bandwidth narrows, the number of non-pump comb lines above a common absolute power threshold increases. Furthermore, the feedback phase controls the DDS duty cycle and intracavity comb-line power distribution, while the increase of the pump power improves the estimated pump-to-comb output conversion efficiency.

summaries.en: This numerical study shows that pure high even-order normal dispersion supports self-injection-locked dissipative dark-soliton Kerr microcombs formed by interlocked switching waves that can be directly excited without detuning sweeps, with higher dispersion orders lengthening the switching-wave tail oscillation period, slowing its decay, narrowing overall bandwidth yet increasing the number of non-pump comb lines above a fixed power threshold, while feedback phase sets the duty cycle and intracavity power distribution and higher pump power improves estimated pump-to-comb conversion efficiency.
summaries.zh: 该数值研究表明，纯高阶偶数阶正常色散可支持由互锁切换波形成的自注入锁定耗散暗孤子克尔微梳，无需扫描失谐即可直接激发；随着色散阶数升高，切换波尾振荡周期增大、衰减变慢，总梳带宽变窄但超过统一绝对功率阈值的非泵浦梳线数量增加，同时反馈相位控制暗孤子占空比和腔内梳线功率分布，而提高泵浦功率可改善估算的泵浦到梳输出转换效率。
summaries.ja: この数値研究は、純粋な高次偶数次正常分散が、離調掃引なしで直接励起できる相互ロックしたスイッチング波からなる自己注入同期型の散逸暗ソリトンKerrマイクロコムを支持することを示し、分散次数が高くなるとスイッチング波の尾部振動周期が長く減衰が遅くなり、全体のコム帯域幅は狭まるものの共通の絶対パワー閾値を超える非ポンプコム線の数が増加し、フィードバック位相が暗ソリトンのデューティ比と腔内コム線パワー分布を制御し、ポンプパワーの増加が推定ポンプ対コム出力変換効率を向上させることを明らかにした。

title: Optical microscopy for pathological imaging: past, present, and future
abstract: Histopathology, the microscopic examination of stained tissue sections, remains the gold standard for pathology imaging, but its bright-field imaging is largely morphological. Advanced optical microscopy techniques move beyond this by exploiting diverse light-matter interactions, and are increasingly applied to pathological imaging. By capturing signals such as refractive index, polarisation, harmonic generation, Brillouin shift, and molecular vibrations, these microscopy techniques can provide quantitative or semi-quantitative information on tissue structure, mechanics, and chemical or molecular composition. In this review, we summarise the physical principles, key quantitative parameters, and representative pathological applications of seven modalities--optical diffraction tomography, polarisation microscopy, second-harmonic generation microscopy, third-harmonic generation microscopy, Brillouin microscopy, Raman microscopy, and fluorescence microscopy. We also discuss progress in artificial intelligence that supports reconstruction, analysis, and interpretation across these modalities, together with emerging trends in multimodal integration. Overall, this review shows how different optical contrasts can complement routine histopathology, while outlining the challenges and opportunities that will shape their clinical translation.

summaries.en: This review summarizes the physical principles, quantitative parameters, and pathological applications of seven advanced optical microscopy modalities—optical diffraction tomography, polarisation microscopy, second- and third-harmonic generation microscopy, Brillouin microscopy, Raman microscopy, and fluorescence microscopy—that exploit diverse light-matter interactions to complement conventional bright-field histopathology, and discusses AI-enabled reconstruction and analysis as well as emerging multimodal integration trends and the challenges and opportunities for clinical translation.
summaries.zh: 本综述总结了七种先进光学显微技术——光学衍射层析、偏振显微、二次与三次谐波产生显微、布里渊显微、拉曼显微和荧光显微——的物理原理、关键定量参数及代表性病理学应用，这些技术利用多样的光与物质相互作用来补充传统明场组织病理学，并讨论了支持各模态重建、分析与解释的人工智能进展、多模态整合的新兴趋势以及临床转化所面临的挑战与机遇。
summaries.ja: 本レビューは、光学回折トモグラフィー、偏光顕微鏡、第二・第三高調波発生顕微鏡、ブリルアン顕微鏡、ラマン顕微鏡、蛍光顕微鏡という7つの先端光学顕微鏡法について、その物理原理、主要な定量パラメータ、代表的な病理応用をまとめ、多様な光と物質の相互作用を利用して従来の明視野組織病理学を補完するこれらの技術を概説するとともに、各モダリティの再構成・解析・解釈を支える人工知能の進展、マルチモーダル統合の新たな動向、臨床応用に向けた課題と機会を論じている。

title: Domain-Adapted Deep Optical Flow for Multiphase Velocimetry in Unsteady Cloud Cavitation
abstract: Time-resolved velocimetry inside cloud cavitation remains a fundamental measurement problem. Particle image velocimetry (PIV) requires uniform tracer seeding and undistorted particle images, and cavitating flow violates both, because tracers do not penetrate vapor structures and refractive index mismatch across deforming interfaces produces spurious vectors. We present a domain-adapted deep optical flow framework for two-phase velocimetry, built on a Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms (RAFT) architecture fine-tuned on synthetic image pairs rendered from multiphase OpenFOAM simulations (RAFT-CloudCav). It is evaluated against a pre-trained generalist RAFT model, Farnebäck and OpenPIV on 130,000 frames/s recordings of a Venturi test section at 30 and 48 L/min. As no experimental ground truth exists, validation uses three quantities that require none, namely the integrated flow rate against a turbine meter, the liquid-phase velocity divergence, which mass conservation requires to vanish, and the station-to-station spread of the flow rate. RAFT-CloudCav recovers 47.75 L/min against a metered 48.0 $\pm$ 0.5 L/min, the closest of the four methods, and its flow rate varies by 2.0% across four streamwise stations, versus 6-7% for the classical methods. It returns a coherent near-wall reverse flow of -0.71 m/s, the time-averaged signature of the upstream-propagating re-entrant jet, where OpenPIV returns none. In the non-cavitating control, at 51 $\mu$m/pixel only three grid points fall inside a 0.68 mm boundary layer and the peak wall-normal gradient is under-predicted more than thirtyfold, while 13 and 19 $\mu$m/pixel agree with each other. The mean field is recovered without tracer particles at roughly three times the per-frame uncertainty. Uncertainties are estimated a posteriori from the image residual and propagated conservatively.
subjects: Fluid Dynamics (physics.flu-dyn) ; Data Analysis, Statistics and Probability (physics.data-an)

summaries.en: A domain-adapted RAFT optical flow model fine-tuned on synthetic multiphase OpenFOAM images, RAFT-CloudCav, outperforms generalist RAFT, Farnebäck and OpenPIV for two-phase velocimetry in unsteady cloud cavitation, recovering 47.
summaries.zh: 一种基于RAFT并在多相OpenFOAM模拟生成的合成图像上微调的域适应光流模型RAFT-CloudCav，用于非定常云空化中的两相测速，其性能优于通用RAFT、Farnebäck和OpenPIV，测得流量为47.
summaries.ja: 多相OpenFOAMシミュレーションから生成した合成画像でファインチューニングしたドメイン適応型RAFTオプティカルフローモデルRAFT-CloudCavは、非定常クラウドキャビテーションにおける二相流速計測で汎用RAFT、Farnebäck、OpenPIVを上回り、タービン流量計の48.

title: An acousto-optic colorimeter for color psychophysics
abstract: A complete model of human color perception requires the ability to present any color as a this http URL existing measurements were collected with physical color samples, and current laboratory generators, such as displays and multi-primary LED systems, work with a small number of fixed primaries. Published color-difference data therefore cover about 40\% of the CIE~$xy$ chromaticity diagram, while commercial wide-gamut displays already reach two thirds of it and need difference metrics there. We describe an acousto-optic colorimeter that lets the experimenter choose the primaries. The device selects up to four narrow bands from a supercontinuum (white-light) laser, each with electronically set wavelength and intensity, and covers 95\% of the CIE~$xy$ chromaticity diagram. Threshold-scale color differences, presented in alternation as in a discrimination experiment, are reproduced with a mean error of 0.08--0.12 CIEDE2000 units ($\Delta E_{00}$) at five CIE-recommended color centers. Because one color can be built from many combinations of narrow bands, the bands are chosen for the task: the finest adjustment for color matching, the least disagreement between observers for color-difference measurement. In simulations with 151~individual observers from a published dataset, with these bands observers see colors 0.6--1.9~$\Delta E_{00}$ from the intended one on average, against 1.2--2.5~$\Delta E_{00}$ on a calibrated wide-gamut LCD, lower at every center. The approach applies to any narrowband source and lets experimenters use saturated colors while limiting the effect of individual differences in color vision.

summaries.en: An acousto-optic colorimeter using a supercontinuum laser with up to four electronically tunable narrow bands covers 95% of the CIE xy chromaticity diagram and reproduces threshold-scale color differences with a mean error of 0.
summaries.zh: 一种声光色度计利用超连续谱激光器选取最多四个波长和强度均可电子调控的窄带，覆盖CIE xy色度图的95%，并在五个CIE推荐色心处将阈值量级的色差以0.
summaries.ja: 超連続発光レーザーから最大4つの狭帯域を波長・強度とも電子的に選択する音響光学色度計はCIE xy色度図の95%を覆い、CIE推奨の5つの色中心において閾値スケールの色差を平均誤差0.

title: Low-Rank Iteration for Efficient Calculations of Topological Surface States
abstract: Surface states are hallmarks of topological phases, and their efficient computation is crucial for topology characterization. Conventional supercell methods (SCM) approximate semi-infinite systems as finite periodic ones, but suffer from high computational cost, artificial inter-surface coupling, and slow convergence near band edges. Recently, boundary problems for semi-infinite systems have been recast as block-tridiagonal equations and solved by the cyclic reduction method (CRM) and the transfer matrix method (TMM). However, these approaches remain resource-intensive, as fine-mesh discretization produces very large matrices. Recognizing the intrinsic sparsity and low rank of these matrices, we develop a low-rank iterative method (LIM) with stochastic trace estimation that substantially reduces complexity and memory without sacrificing accuracy, while remaining straightforwardly parallelizable. Benchmarks on 2D and 3D topological systems show orders-of-magnitude acceleration over CRM and TMM. LIM extends readily to heterostructures, defective interfaces, and non-Hermitian systems, providing an efficient platform for topological and plasmonic surface phenomena.

summaries.en: The authors introduce a low-rank iterative method with stochastic trace estimation that exploits the sparsity and low rank of block-tridiagonal boundary equations to compute topological surface states far more efficiently than cyclic reduction or transfer matrix methods, achieving orders-of-magnitude speedups on 2D and 3D topological systems while remaining accurate and parallelizable.
summaries.zh: 作者提出了一种结合随机迹估计的低秩迭代方法，利用块三对角边界方程的内在稀疏性和低秩性来计算拓扑表面态，相比循环约化法和转移矩阵法在二维和三维拓扑体系上实现了数量级的加速，同时保持精度且易于并行化。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、ブロック三重対角境界方程式の本質的な疎性と低ランク性を利用し、確率的トレース推定を伴う低ランク反復法を開発することで、循環還元法や転送行列法よりもはるかに効率的にトポロジカル表面状態を計算し、二次元・三次元トポロジカル系で精度を保ちつつ並列化可能なまま桁違いの高速化を達成した。

title: When is an Optical Design Problem a Mass Transfer Problem?
abstract: This paper investigates whether optical design problems can be represented as Monge--Kantorovich mass transfer problems with some cost function. An optical problem is specified by a function defining a particular family of supporting surfaces for the optical element. We introduce the notion of geometric equivalence between optical and transport problems, which is directly related to the possibility of formulating an optical design problem as a mass transfer problem. A necessary condition for such equivalence is derived in the semi-discrete setting. It allows a transport representation to be ruled out without choosing a cost function in advance. The condition is applied to the near-field refractor problem and to the design of two refracting surfaces transforming a spherical beam into a spherical or collimated beam. For these problems, the necessary condition is shown to fail in physically admissible configurations. We also study an optical element with a single working surface and an arbitrary regular incident wavefront. In the far field, geometric equivalence to a mass transfer problem requires a planar or spherical wavefront, whereas in the near field with a planar target, the necessary condition fails for an arbitrary smooth wavefront.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a notion of geometric equivalence between optical design problems and Monge–Kantorovich mass transfer problems and derives a necessary condition, in the semi-discrete setting, that can rule out a transport representation without preselecting a cost function, showing that this condition fails for the near-field refractor problem and for designing two refracting surfaces that transform a spherical beam into a spherical or collimated beam, while a single working surface with an arbitrary incident wavefront is geometrically equivalent only for planar or spherical wavefronts in the far field and fails in the near field with a planar target.
summaries.zh: 本文引入了光学设计问题与Monge–Kantorovich质量传输问题之间的几何等价概念，并在半离散情形下推导出一个无需预先选定代价函数即可排除传输表示的必要条件，证明该条件在近场折射器问题以及将球面光束转换为球面或准直光束的双折射面设计中不成立，同时表明对于具有任意入射波前的单一工作表面，远场中几何等价要求波前为平面或球面，而在平面目标的近场情形下该必要条件对任意光滑波前均不成立。
summaries.ja: 本論文は光学設計問題とMonge–Kantorovich質量輸送問題の間の幾何学的同値性の概念を導入し、半離散設定においてコスト関数を事前に選ぶことなく輸送表現を排除できる必要条件を導出し、この条件が近接場屈折器問題や球面ビームを球面またはコリメートビームに変換する2つの屈折面の設計では成立しないことを示すとともに、任意の入射波面をもつ単一作用面では遠方場では平面または球面波面の場合にのみ幾何学的同値性が成立し、平面標的をもつ近接場では任意の滑らかな波面に対して必要条件が成立しないことを明らかにする。

title: Redetermination of the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients of BaMgF4
abstract: BaMgF4 (BMF) has the potential to serve as a platform material for vacuum-ultraviolet (VUV) nonlinear optics owing to its ferroelectricity and high UV transparency down to 130 nm. However, the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients reported for BMF span approximately one order of magnitude, hindering a reliable assessment of its potential for nonlinear optical applications. Here, we redetermined these coefficients by combining Maker fringe, wedge, and single-pass second-harmonic-generation measurements at a fundamental wavelength of 1064 nm. Our results establish that all the second-order nonlinear optical coefficients of BMF lie in the range of 0.01-0.04 pm/V. We determined d31 to be 0.035 pm/V, which is among the largest coefficients of BMF, while it has been underestimated relative to the other coefficients in previous studies. Although d31 is not the largest coefficient, the use of its long corresponding coherence length is beneficial for quasi-phase matching, particularly for VUV generation, where the fabrication of lower-order quasi-phase-matching structures is crucial.

summaries.en: By combining Maker fringe, wedge, and single-pass second-harmonic-generation measurements at 1064 nm, this study redetermines all second-order nonlinear optical coefficients of BaMgF4 to lie within 0.
summaries.zh: 本研究结合Maker条纹、楔形和单程二次谐波产生三种方法，在1064 nm基频波长下重新测定了BaMgF4的全部二阶非线性光学系数，确定其范围为0.
summaries.ja: 本研究は1064 nmの基本波においてMakerフリンジ法、ウェッジ法、およびシングルパス第二高調波発生測定を組み合わせることで、BaMgF4の全ての二次非線形光学係数が0.

title: Stable, High-Charge, Laser-Driven VHEE Beams for Preclinical Applications
abstract: Laser-driven plasma accelerators (LPAs) are promising sources of very-high-energy-electron (VHEE) beams for medical applications, but increasing charge per pulse while maintaining pointing stability remains challenging. We demonstrate laser-accelerated beams with total charge per pulse reaching (559 $\pm$ 56) pC using an 80 TW laser system. The spectra have a dominant component at 40-60 MeV and a high-energy tail extending to approximately 200 MeV. Pointing jitter measured in air at the irradiation target plane reaches as low as 0.7 mrad. The beams were used for VHEE irradiation experiments involving a 10 mm region of interest through a 40 mm depth at 400 $\pm$ 20 mGy/pulse. Spectral reproducibility is quantified over fixed-setting shot sequences. Particle-in-cell simulations produce a peak-and-tail spectrum through acceleration in successive bubbles associated with a strongly modified plasma wake, providing a plausible mechanism for maintaining substantial accelerated charge despite strong beam loading. Dose-weighted time-of-flight calculations indicate an effective pulse dose rate of $10^{12}$ Gy/s and average dose rates of tens of Gy/min. These results establish an LPA operating regime relevant to preclinical VHEE irradiation.

summaries.en: Using an 80 TW laser system, the authors produced laser-driven VHEE beams with up to (559 ± 56) pC per pulse, a dominant 40–60 MeV spectrum extending to ~200 MeV, pointing jitter as low as 0.
summaries.zh: 作者利用80 TW激光系统产生了激光驱动的VHEE束流，单脉冲总电荷最高达(559 ± 56) pC，能谱主成分位于40–60 MeV并延伸至约200 MeV，指向抖动低至0.
summaries.ja: 80 TWレーザーシステムを用いて、パルスあたり最大(559 ± 56) pCの電荷、40–60 MeVを主成分とし約200 MeVまで伸びるスペクトル、0.

title: TwinLight: A Multi-Timescale Physical-Layer-Aware T-API-Compliant Optical Domain Controller Digital Twin
abstract: We demonstrate TwinLight, an open-source optical-network digital twin acting as an optical domain controller. Its T-API REST and telemetry streaming interfaces expose a physical-layer engine that combines a GNPy steady-state baseline with four analytical transients.

summaries.en: TwinLight is an open-source optical-network digital twin that serves as an optical domain controller, exposing through T-API REST and telemetry streaming interfaces a physical-layer engine that combines a GNPy steady-state baseline with four analytical transients.
summaries.zh: TwinLight 是一个开源的光网络数字孪生，充当光域控制器，通过 T-API REST 和遥测流接口对外提供物理层引擎，该引擎将 GNPy 稳态基线与四个解析暂态模型相结合。
summaries.ja: TwinLightは光ドメインコントローラとして機能するオープンソースの光ネットワークデジタルツインであり、T-API RESTとテレメトリストリーミングのインターフェースを通じて、GNPyによる定常状態ベースラインと4つの解析的過渡応答を組み合わせた物理層エンジンを公開する。

title: Reconstructing intracell polarization with calibrated sapphire-window optics for collimated blue-light generation in a rubidium cell
abstract: We study the polarization dependence of collimated blue light (CBL) generated near 420~nm by resonant four-wave mixing in thermal rubidium vapor in a sapphire-window cell driven at 780 and 776~nm. Sapphire windows can transform the polarization of pump light before it reaches the vapor, complicating the interpretation of polarization-dependent nonlinear emission. We measured the 780-nm pump Stokes state at an external before-cell reference plane to calibrate the common HWP/QWP preparation optics and recorded 266 off-resonant external output Stokes states after the complete sapphire-window rubidium cell at 90, 100, and 110~$^\circ$C in two propagation orientations. Direct paired-wavelength measurements show a mean before-cell 780/776 separation of $4.29^\circ$ and temperature- and orientation-specific complete-cell rotations of $22.20^\circ$--$32.02^\circ$, with rms residuals of $4.83^\circ$--$12.87^\circ$. Using this calibrated co-prepared pump description, we analyzed 2574 measurements of total spectrally filtered 420-nm CBL intensity. Across the six temperature--orientation data sets, a complete nine-coefficient second-order response yielded cross-validated $R^2$ values of 0.636 to 0.828. These paired-wavelength measurements establish, for each temperature--orientation data set, a fixed relative Stokes-space map between the two co-prepared pump trajectories, with the residual of this mapping defining the experimental uncertainty of the correlated two-pump reduction used in the response model. Thus, the resulting framework combines a reconstructed vapor-entrance polarization coordinate with direct two-wavelength calibration of the assembled cell and provides a practical basis for polarization-controlled nonlinear-optical experiments in sapphire-window vapor cells.

summaries.en: By calibrating the Stokes polarization of 780- and 776-nm pumps at an external reference plane and tracking sapphire-window-induced rotations through the full rubidium cell at multiple temperatures and orientations, the authors establish a fixed relative Stokes-space map between the two co-prepared pump trajectories and use it to model 420-nm collimated blue light with a nine-coefficient second-order response achieving cross-validated R² of 0.
summaries.zh: 通过在校外参考面标定780 nm和776 nm泵浦光的斯托克斯偏振，并追踪蓝宝石窗口在多个温度和取向下引起的完整铷泡偏振旋转，作者建立了两个共制备泵浦轨迹之间固定的相对斯托克斯空间映射，并据此用九系数二阶响应模型描述420 nm准直蓝光，交叉验证R²达到0.
summaries.ja: 外部参照面で780 nmおよび776 nmポンプ光のストークス偏光を校正し、複数の温度と配置でサファイア窓を通したルビジウムセル全体における偏光回転を追跡することで、著者らは共準備された2つのポンプ軌道間の固定された相対ストークス空間写像を確立し、これに基づく9係数二次応答モデルで420 nmコリメート青光源を記述し、交差検証R²が0.

title: Interface-driven second harmonic generation in indium tin oxide/gold nanolayers: density and mass discontinuities matter
abstract: Second harmonic generation from transparent conductive oxides and metals is traditionally attributed to Coulomb, magnetic Lorentz, and convective sources. We show that this picture is incomplete in deeply subwavelength indium tin oxide/gold bilayers. Measurements reveal two robust spectral features, a broad maximum near 1000 nm and an epsilon-near-zero peak near 1350 nm, that persist across wide variations in material and excitation parameters. Hydrodynamic-Maxwell simulations identify an interface-specific convective mechanism activated by freeelectron density and effective-mass discontinuities at the oxide-metal boundary. As electronic homogenization develops across the bilayer, the response evolves toward one described by conventional Coulomb, Lorentz, and leading convective terms. These results establish second harmonic generation as a sensitive probe of interface-driven nonlinearities and suggest a broader role for electronic discontinuities in shaping nonlinear optical processes at surface and buried material interfaces.

summaries.en: In deeply subwavelength indium tin oxide/gold bilayers, second harmonic generation is driven by an interface-specific convective mechanism arising from free-electron density and effective-mass discontinuities at the oxide-metal boundary, producing robust spectral features near 1000 nm and an epsilon-near-zero peak near 1350 nm.
summaries.zh: 在深亚波长的氧化铟锡/金双层结构中，二次谐波产生由氧化物-金属界面处自由电子密度与有效质量不连续性所激发的界面特异性对流机制主导，并在约1000纳米处产生宽峰、在约1350纳米处产生epsilon-near-zero峰。
summaries.ja: 深いサブ波長の酸化インジウムスズ/金二層膜において、第二高調波発生は酸化物-金属界面での自由電子密度と有効質量の不連続性に起因する界面特有の対流機構によって駆動され、約1000 nmのブロードな極大と約1350 nmのイプシロン近零ピークという頑健なスペクトル特徴を生じる。

title: A hair-thin implant opens the entire depth of the mouse brain to revisiting the same structures at subcellular resolution
abstract: Ultrathin multimode-fibre endoscopes provide minimally invasive access to subcellular structures throughout the depth of the mouse brain. Here we introduce a chronically implantable interface with a diameter of 144 {\mu}m, about the thickness of a human hair, that extends this capability to longitudinal imaging, enabling repeated access to the same fine structures over extended periods. The system supports weeks-long tracking of individual dendritic spines, allowing quantitative comparison of their dynamics and survival across dendritic compartments. We further demonstrate longitudinal intracellular calcium imaging during spontaneous and stimulus-evoked activity in the same cells across days, as well as repeated measurements of blood flow in the same vessels across multiple brain regions. This chronic endomicroscopic platform provides stable, minimally invasive optical access for longitudinal subcellular-resolution imaging of brain structure, activity and blood flow across depth.

summaries.en: A chronically implantable 144-micrometre multimode-fibre endoscope enables repeated, minimally invasive longitudinal imaging of dendritic spines, intracellular calcium activity and blood flow at subcellular resolution throughout the depth of the mouse brain.
summaries.zh: 一种直径144微米、可长期植入的多模光纤内窥镜能够在整个小鼠大脑深度内以亚细胞分辨率反复、微创地对同一结构进行纵向成像，实现树突棘、细胞内钙活动和血流的长期追踪。
summaries.ja: 直径144マイクロメートルの慢性的に移植可能なマルチモードファイバー内視鏡により、マウス脳の全深度にわたり同一構造へサブセルラー分解能で繰り返し低侵襲にアクセスし、樹状突起スパイン、細胞内カルシウム活動、血流の長期イメージングが可能となった。

title: Layer-Peeling Inversion of Temporal Refractive Index Profiles from Noisy Data
abstract: We introduce a direct method for reconstructing the temporal evolution of a medium from electromagnetic field measurements. A sequence of temporal refractive-index changes splits an incident wave into forward- and backward-propagating components, producing a \emph{spatial} response of finite extent. We show that this finite support, together with causality, enables sequential reconstruction of the temporal interfaces through a time-domain extension of layer peeling. For continuously varying media, we introduce a time-adjusted Goupillaud medium and, through space-time duality, establish the corresponding momentum-conservation and admissibility conditions. The method remains robust under incomplete and noisy measurements, providing a general framework for the metrology, characterization, and design of time-varying electromagnetic systems.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a direct time-domain layer-peeling inversion method that reconstructs temporal refractive-index profiles from electromagnetic field measurements by exploiting the finite spatial support and causality of the scattered response, remaining robust under incomplete and noisy data.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种直接的时域层剥离反演方法，利用散射响应的有限空间支撑与因果性，从电磁场测量中重建时间折射率分布，并且在测量不完整和含噪声的情况下仍保持稳健。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、散乱応答の有限な空間的サポートと因果性を利用して電磁場測定から時間的屈折率プロファイルを再構成する直接的な時間領域層剥離反転法を提案し、不完全で雑音を含む測定においても頑健であることを示す。

title: Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics: An eT-i-PI Interface for Ab Initio Cavity Born-Oppenheimer Dynamics and Joint Nuclear-Photon Path-Integral Sampling
abstract: Simulating molecules in quantum electrodynamic (QED) cavities requires a consistent description of electronic response, nuclear motion, and electromagnetic-field fluctuations. Here, I present Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics, an interface connecting eT and i-PI for atomistic simulations of finite molecular systems coupled to a single photon mode. The code evaluates a self-consistent cavity Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock (CBO-HF) energy surface and supports classical-nuclei dynamics under canonical (NVT) and microcanonical (NVE) ensembles, as well as canonical joint nuclear-photon path-integral sampling including nuclear quantum effects (NQEs). A fixed-displacement gradient correction provides nuclear and photon forces consistent with the same energy surface as the photon coordinate evolves independently. OpenMP threading, concurrent bead evaluations, and analysis utilities support practical simulations. Water-monomer benchmarks assess both dynamical propagation and equilibrium sampling. Energy-derivative checks and NVE timestep tests demonstrate consistent force evaluation and integration, while path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations with PILE-L thermostatting reproduce analytic finite-bead photon second moments, including their centroid and internal contributions, within sampling uncertainties. At the tested parameters, cavity coupling produces a small but statistically resolved increase in photon fluctuations, while changes in mean molecular geometry remain within sampling uncertainty. The resulting Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics framework enables controlled investigations of how coupled quantum fluctuations of matter and the electromagnetic field influence molecular equilibrium properties within the CBO-HF approximation, providing a foundation for future studies of cavity-modified hydrogen bonding, vibrational spectra, and molecular polaritonic phenomena.

summaries.en: The paper presents Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics, an eT–i-PI interface that enables ab initio cavity Born–Oppenheimer Hartree–Fock dynamics and canonical joint nuclear–photon path-integral sampling for molecules coupled to a single photon mode, validated on a water monomer against analytic finite-bead photon second moments.
summaries.zh: 本文介绍了Cavity-QED Molecular Dynamics，这是一个连接eT与i-PI的接口，可对与单光子模式耦合的分子进行从头算腔Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock动力学模拟以及包含核量子效应的正则联合核-光子路径积分采样，并在水分子单体上验证了其光子的有限珠子二阶矩与解析结果一致。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、eTとi-PIを接続するCavity-QED Molecular Dynamicsインターフェースを提示し、単一光子モードと結合した分子に対して第一原理腔Born-Oppenheimer Hartree-Fock動力学と核量子効果を含む正準的な核-光子経路積分サンプリングを可能にし、水単量体で有限ビーズ光子二次モーメントが解析値と一致することを検証した。

title: Magnon-polaritons in terahertz resonators based on antiferromagnets with weak ferromagnetism
abstract: Terahertz magnon-polaritons in antiferromagnets with weak ferromagnetism are theoretically investigated using YFeO$_3$ as an example. Dispersion relations are obtained for the quasi-ferromagnetic and quasi-antiferromagnetic modes. It is shown that the intrinsic Fabry--Perot resonances of the magnetic slab provide strong coupling, but their low quality factor limits the cooperativity. The photonic crystal cavity increases the cooperativity of the quasi-antiferromagnetic mode from $C\sim6$ to $C\sim41$ at 300K and to $2.2\times10^3$ at 63K.

summaries.en: This theoretical study of YFeO3 shows that intrinsic Fabry-Perot resonances in a weakly ferromagnetic antiferromagnetic slab strongly couple to terahertz magnon-polaritons but have limited cooperativity due to low quality factors, whereas a photonic crystal cavity raises the quasi-antiferromagnetic mode cooperativity from about 6 to about 41 at 300 K and to 2.
summaries.zh: 这项以YFeO3为例的理论研究表明，弱铁磁反铁磁薄板的本征法布里-珀罗共振能与太赫兹磁振子极化激元实现强耦合，但其低品质因子限制了协同度，而光子晶体腔可将准反铁磁模式的协同度从约6提高到300 K下的约41以及63 K下的2.
summaries.ja: YFeO3を例としたこの理論研究では、弱い強磁性を持つ反強磁性スラブの固有ファブリ・ペロー共鳴がテラヘルツ磁気ポラリトンと強く結合するものの低い品質因子により協同性が制限される一方、フォトニック結晶共振器により準反強磁性モードの協同性が約6から300 Kで約41、63 Kで2.

title: Vertically-coupled microring resonators for lithium niobate on insulator integrated photonics
abstract: We propose and demonstrate lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) microring resonators that are verticallycoupled to index-matched silicon-rich silicon nitride (SiN x ) access waveguides as an alternative to conventional lateral coupling schemes for integrated photonics applications. The wafer-scalable fabrication process involves a planarization step exploiting a single-step and reproducible spin-coating of a SU-8 epoxy spacer layer which allows a controlled separation to be established between the resonator and its access waveguide. The resulting multimode and single-mode microring resonators exhibit, for their fundamental TE 0 mode, intrinsic quality factors of 4.0 x 10 5 and 3.4 x 10 5 , respectively.

summaries.en: The authors propose and demonstrate lithium niobate on insulator microring resonators vertically coupled to index-matched silicon-rich silicon nitride access waveguides via a reproducible SU-8 spin-coated spacer layer, achieving intrinsic quality factors of 4.
summaries.zh: 作者提出并演示了通过可重复的SU-8旋涂间隔层与折射率匹配的富硅氮化硅接入波导垂直耦合的绝缘体上铌酸锂微环谐振器，其多模和单模谐振器在基模TE0下分别实现了4.
summaries.ja: 著者らは、再現性の高いSU-8スピンコートスペーサー層を介して屈折率整合したシリコンリッチ窒化ケイ素アクセス導波路と垂直結合するリチウムナイオベート・オン・インシュレータ微小リング共振器を提案・実証し、多モードおよび単一モード共振器の基本TE0モードでそれぞれ4.

title: Probing injection locking of an integrated nanolaser pair through RF beating
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous optical injection locking of an integrated pair of photonic-crystal nanolasers coupled to a common silicon waveguide. Due to fabrication-induced disorder, the two nanolasers exhibit distinct emission wavelengths, allowing their individual locking ranges to be resolved as a function of the injection-laser detuning and power. We identify a region where both nanolasers are simultaneously locked to the master laser. To probe this collective locked state, the two nanolasers are independently pump-modulated at distinct radio frequencies. A beat note at the difference frequency appears only within the overlap region, providing a direct RF signature of simultaneous locking. These results establish RF beating as a compact diagnostic of common-master injection locking in integrated nanolaser systems.

summaries.en: This study demonstrates simultaneous optical injection locking of two photonic-crystal nanolasers coupled to a common silicon waveguide and uses radio-frequency beat notes from independent pump modulation at distinct frequencies to directly verify the collective locked state, establishing RF beating as a compact diagnostic of common-master injection locking in integrated nanolaser systems.
summaries.zh: 本研究展示了耦合到同一硅波导的两个光子晶体纳米激光器可实现同时光注入锁定，并利用对不同射频频率的独立泵浦调制所产生的拍频信号直接验证该集体锁定状态，从而确立了射频拍频作为集成纳米激光器系统中共同主激光注入锁定的一种紧凑诊断方法。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、共通のシリコン導波路に結合した2つのフォトニック結晶ナノレーザの同時光注入同期を実証し、異なる無線周波数での独立したポンプ変調によるビート信号を用いて集団的な同期状態を直接検証することで、RFビートを集積ナノレーザ系における共通マスタ注入同期のコンパクトな診断手法として確立した。

title: Time-gated optical-parametric-amplification and field-resolved detection of mid-infrared free-induction decay signals
abstract: Infrared spectroscopy is a key tool to study complex structural dynamics in molecular systems. However, resolving weak or broad vibrational modes is challenging due to their rapid decay. Here, we demonstrate a technique to significantly extend the detectable lifetime - and thereby spectral resolution - of molecular signatures by employing synchronized time-gated optical parametric amplification of mid-infrared free-induction decay signals. Utilizing a Cr:ZnS laser system and a nonlinear ZnGeP2 crystal, we achieve a 10-fold increase in the electric field strength of the infrared molecular signal, yielding a two-orders of magnitude enhancement in dynamic range and a 2-fold increase in the signal-to-noise ratio. Using isopropyl alcohol as a model system, we demonstrate that OPA-enhanced detection extends the observable window of vibrational modes up to 72 %. This approach allows for the reconstruction of high-fidelity molecular fingerprints that resolve complex vibrational relaxation pathways and weak structural dynamics, previously hidden within the background and noise, providing a pathway for new high-sensitivity and time-resolved studies of complex chemical structures.

summaries.en: Using synchronized time-gated optical parametric amplification of mid-infrared free-induction decay signals with a Cr:ZnS laser and a ZnGeP2 crystal, the authors achieve a 10-fold increase in electric field strength, two orders of magnitude greater dynamic range, and a 2-fold higher signal-to-noise ratio, extending the observable vibrational-mode window by up to 72% and enabling reconstruction of high-fidelity molecular fingerprints.
summaries.zh: 作者采用Cr:ZnS激光系统与ZnGeP2晶体对中红外自由感应衰减信号进行同步时间门控光参量放大，使电场强度提高10倍、动态范围提升两个数量级、信噪比提高2倍，并将可观测振动模式窗口延长至多72%，从而能够重建高保真分子指纹。
summaries.ja: Cr:ZnSレーザー系とZnGeP2結晶を用いて中赤外自由誘導減衰信号を同期時間ゲート光パラメトリック増幅することで、電場強度を10倍、ダイナミックレンジを2桁、信号対雑音比を2倍向上させ、観測可能な振動モードの窓を最大72%拡張して高忠実度の分子フィンガープリントの再構成を可能にした。

title: Quantum-enabled measurement of gravitational forces at the milligram scale
abstract: Gravity is by far the weakest among all known interactions. While it dominates the large-scale structure of the universe, gravitational interactions between small masses in the microscopic range remain underexplored because they are too weak to be experimentally accessible. The interface between gravity, described by general relativity, and quantum mechanics, which describes the microscopic world, is of particular interest. From a theory standpoint, these two major descriptions of nature have not been combined in a satisfactory manner. Technology is gradually becoming mature enough such that probing gravity at the microscopic scale, where quantum mechanics and gravity potentially meet, is becoming accessible. Explorations towards genuine quantum gravity have to be carried out under conditions where the gravitating masses possess non-classical properties, which necessitates ultimate protection against disturbances, such as ultralow temperatures and a small range of motion. Here, we present an experiment at millikelvin temperatures, where the gravity due to a micron-range coherent displacement of an 87 mg source mass imprints on the motion of an oscillating membrane loaded with a 1.3 mg test mass. Vibrations of the membrane are measured in the microwave optomechanical scheme, which is a key setup for investigating non-classical motional states of mechanical oscillators. When considering the combination of total source and test masses, our setup presents two orders of magnitude progress in sensing gravity at the small scale, as well as a 35 dB improvement of gravitational sensitivity at kHz frequencies or above. Our setup offers a plausible approach for studying gravitational interactions between masses prepared in non-classical motional states.

title: Neutral-atom quantum features as complementary structural encodings for graph learning
abstract: Structural descriptors provide graph neural networks (GNNs) with positional and topological inductive biases. However, widely used classical encodings based on random walks or Laplacian spectra emphasize specific structural statistics of a graph, leaving room for alternative descriptors. Neutral-atom quantum processing units (QPUs) can realize graph-dependent Rydberg Hamiltonians, allowing graph topology to be probed through dynamical correlation measurements. In this work, we use these measurements as quantum graph features (QGFs), providing a complementary, hardware-derived family of structural encoding that is not accurately described by classical features derived from Laplacian and adjacency matrices, even when supplemented with an extended set of random-walk, geometric descriptors and classical physical models. By appropriately selecting the quench parameters of the Hamiltonian, we access two characteristic correlation regimes with distinct structural signatures: antiferromagnetic-like and ferromagnetic-like. On an intrinsic information benchmark of 15 topological and spectral probing tasks, quantum and hybrid quantum-classical features match or surpass classical descriptors on local topological properties. When supplied to message-passing, attention, and graph-transformer backbones, hybrid quantum-classical features yield improvements that are within cross-fold noise on most cells but sign-consistent across architectures. When comparing noiseless, shot-sampled emulation-derived quantum features with a neutral-atom QPU implementation, the downstream hybrid results with compressed hardware features match their emulated counterparts within $0.01$ F$_1$ on all backbones. On a synthetic family of ladder graphs, QGFs distinguish two specific classes, outperforming the strongest classical structural descriptors by a margin exceeding cross-fold variability.

title: Time- and phase-resolved emulation of sign-selective counterdiabatic dynamics in a superconducting qutrit
abstract: In cyclic three-level systems, phase-sensitive interference can convert a coupling-sign reversal into a population contrast, providing a controllable analogue of handedness. We emulate this mechanism in a superconducting transmon qutrit using two resonant single-photon drives and a phase-controlled effective two-photon drive. Effective loop phases \(\Phi_L=+\pi/2\) and \(\Phi_R=-\pi/2\), separated by \(\pi\), reverse the auxiliary contribution to the dark--bright coupling, canceling the intrinsic nonadiabatic term for \(L\) and reinforcing it for \(R\). Time-resolved trajectories reveal dark-pathway transfer for \(L\) and bright-manifold participation for \(R\). Measured late-time averages give a target-state population contrast of 0.929. Loop-phase measurements establish phase selectivity, while pulse-area and common-mode amplitude scans characterize the operating regime and control sensitivity. These results provide direct time- and phase-domain access to sign-selective counterdiabatic interference in a programmable cyclic qutrit.

summaries.en: Using two resonant single-photon drives and a phase-controlled effective two-photon drive on a superconducting transmon qutrit, the experiment emulates sign-selective counterdiabatic dynamics in which opposite loop phases reverse the auxiliary dark–bright coupling, yielding a measured late-time target-state population contrast of 0.

title: Single-photon scattering by a nanofiber-coupled atomic chain: beyond independent radiation
abstract: We study single-photon scattering by a nanofiber-coupled atomic chain, comparing a full microscopic model with an independent-radiation approximation. We show that nearly equal transmission probabilities can coexist with substantially different transmitted temporal modes, even after adjusting their relative delay. For a reference chain, a decomposition into collective atomic resonances relates this discrepancy mainly to spectral-phase changes caused by the omitted interatomic couplings. Parameter scans delimit this phase-dominated regime, and controlled comparisons separate the effects of coherent exchange and collective decay.

summaries.en: Single-photon scattering by a nanofiber-coupled atomic chain shows that a full microscopic model and an independent-radiation approximation can yield nearly equal transmission probabilities while producing substantially different transmitted temporal modes, with the discrepancy traced mainly to spectral-phase changes from omitted interatomic couplings, delineated by parameter scans and controlled comparisons that separate coherent exchange from collective decay.
summaries.zh: 纳米光纤耦合原子链的单光子散射研究表明，完整微观模型与独立辐射近似可给出几乎相等的透射概率，却产生显著不同的透射时间模式，这一差异主要归因于被忽略的原子间耦合所引起的光谱相位变化，并通过参数扫描和区分相干交换与集体衰减的受控比较界定了该相位主导区域。
